title: Furniture from China for your interior: how to order furniture and lighting without risk
seo_title: Furniture from China: How to Order Without Risk
description: Furniture from China for your interior: where the real savings are, the main risks, how to check quality and sizes, and why to order with your design studio.
lead: Furniture, lighting and materials from China can cut an interior budget significantly. Here is how to order furniture from China for your interior, keep the savings and not lose out on quality or timing.
photo_alt: Entrance hall with built-in wardrobes, a backlit mirror and a bench — Diamond design project
body: The biggest savings are on items with high retail mark-ups: upholstered furniture, light fittings, decor, sanitary ware, porcelain tiles. Buying directly from the manufacturer, you pay the factory price plus logistics.

The final cost consists of the factory price, packaging, freight, customs clearance and delivery to site. So the fair comparison is not the price on a factory website against a showroom price, but the full delivered cost. We calculate it for every item before ordering, so you see the real difference.

The savings really show when you order as a set: furniture, lighting and materials for a whole apartment or house in one shipment. Logistics are then spread across many items instead of eating up the saving on a single sofa.
What is worth ordering from China
lighting: chandeliers, wall lights, track and linear systems
cabinet furniture, tables and dining sets
Made-to-measure furniture for specific niches — kitchens, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets — is often easier to make locally: it has to be measured on site and fitted precisely to the walls.

The best option is usually a combination: built-ins are made locally to measurements, while upholstered furniture, lighting, sanitary ware and decor come from China. You get precision where it is critical and savings where they are largest.

quality does not match the photos

Most of these risks have little to do with Chinese manufacturing as such and a lot to do with ordering without accurate data: catalogue photos, approximate sizes, a colour like in the picture. The more detailed the brief, the fewer the surprises.
order from the design project specification, with exact dimensions and colours
ask for photos and videos of the goods from the factory before shipment
build delivery time into the renovation schedule
work through an intermediary responsible for inspection and logistics

A design project specification is essentially a ready technical brief for the factory: model, dimensions, material, colour, quantity. With it, comparing offers and checking what arrives is much easier. Production and delivery times depend on the items and shipping method, so we fix them in the schedule separately for each shipment.

Ozdoba is the procurement line of CAS Development — our own catalogue of furniture, lighting, sanitary ware and decor sourced directly from factories in China; you can browse it at [Ozdoba (in Ukrainian)](/ozdoba).

Checklist before ordering furniture from China
approve the design project and a specification with the dimensions of every item
check the real dimensions of niches, openings and ceiling heights on site
approve fabric, finish and colour samples
confirm what is included: legs, hardware, lamps, lighting drivers
check that light fittings suit the local electrical standard
agree packaging and inspection terms before shipment
put the delivery date into the renovation schedule so installation does not stall
ordering by eye from catalogue photos without drawings or dimensions
buying furniture before the layout is final — then finding it does not fit the room
forgetting door and lift widths for large items
ordering lighting separately from the lighting plan and scenes
counting on delivery by the end of the renovation without slack in the schedule

[Turnkey furnishing](/en/turnkey-furnishing) with CAS Development starts from $250 per m². For a 70 m² apartment an indicative calculation is 70 × $250 = $17,500. The exact amount comes from the specification: it depends on the number of items and the models chosen.

For a smaller apartment, say 50 m², the calculation is 50 × $250 = $12,500. Furnishing can be ordered on its own or together with the renovation — then furniture and lighting arrive exactly when the property is ready for installation. The minimum order in the Ozdoba catalogue is from $500, and delivery from China takes 30–60 days.
Why it is easier with the studio

When [turnkey procurement](/en/turnkey-procurement) is run by the same team that did the design, items are chosen for the actual drawings, and sizes and colours are checked before ordering. One manager is responsible for both renovation and procurement, and you get reports at every stage.

Interior design starts from $30 per m², renovation from $550 per m²; works carry a 36-month warranty. The studio has been working since 2016 and has completed more than 150 projects. We are based in Kyiv and work across Ukraine, in Europe and worldwide; invoices are issued for companies registered in Ukraine, and EU invoicing is being set up.
faq: Can I order furniture from China without a design project?
Yes, but with a design project the risk of getting sizes, colours and quantities wrong is much lower.
Inspection and replacement terms are agreed before ordering; working through Ozdoba, you have one responsible party.
Is it worth importing furniture from China for a single room?
The biggest benefit comes when you order a set for a whole apartment or house; for one or two items logistics can eat up the saving. Our minimum order is from $500.
How can I check furniture quality before shipment?
Ask for detailed photos and videos of the finished goods from the factory, compare them with the specification and approve shipment only after the check.
